papers.title: Asymptotic analysis of sample average approximations for optimal control problems with uncertain dynamics
papers.authors_text: Maria Soledad Aronna, João Miguel Machado, Oscar Sierra Fonseca
papers.abstract: We study sample average approximations (SAA) of optimal control problems with control-affine dynamics depending on an uncertain parameter. The objective is an expected terminal cost plus a Tikhonov regularization term, and the controls are square-integrable functions subject to pointwise convex constraints. We show that the reduced objective is twice continuously differentiable in the square-integrable topology, so that no two-norm discrepancy arises, and that its Hessian is a Hilbert--Schmidt perturbation of a multiple of the identity. This yields Lipschitz regularity of stationary controls and second-order conditions without gap for polyhedral constraints. For the SAA scheme with sample size $M$, we prove almost sure uniform consistency of the empirical minimizers, convergence rates of order $M^{-1/2}$ for the optimal values, independent of the dimension of the parameter space. We then derive the asymptotic distributions. The optimal values satisfy a central limit theorem, obtained from a functional central limit theorem for the SAA objective. The empirical minimizers are asymptotically Gaussian when the constraints are inactive; under polyhedral constraints, their limit solves a quadratic problem on the critical cone with a Gaussian linear term. We also derive confidence intervals for linear functionals of the optimal control and illustrate the results on two numerical examples.
papers.tldr: This paper develops a second-order asymptotic theory for sample average approximations of control-affine optimal control problems with uncertain parameters, establishing differentiability and well-posedness, almost sure consistency with dimension-free \(M^{-1/2}\) convergence rates, central limit theorems and asymptotic distributions for optimal values and minimizers, and confidence intervals for linear functionals of the optimal control.

detailed_reading.motivation: 实际最优控制问题中，动力学参数、初始状态或模型系数往往只能以概率分布描述，因此需要设计一个对整族系统都表现良好的开环控制，即最小化期望终端代价的平均（风险中性/ensemble）最优控制问题。但该分布通常未知或不可解，只能用数据构造的经验测度近似，于是样本平均近似（SAA）成为自然的求解与统计推断工具。已有工作多只给出 epi-收敛意义下的定性收敛结论，缺少收敛速率、渐近分布与置信区间等定量结果，本文正是为补足这一缺口。
detailed_reading.method: 研究对象是控制仿射、依赖不确定参数的动力学系统，控制取为 L^2([0,T];R^m) 中满足逐点凸约束的函数，目标为期望终端代价加 Tikhonov 正则项。作者先把状态对控制的依赖代入，得到约化目标泛函，并证明它在 L^2 拓扑下二次连续可微、不存在 two-norm discrepancy，且 Hessian 是恒等算子常数倍加上一个 Hilbert–Schmidt 扰动；由此推出驻点控制的 Lipschitz 正则性，以及多面体约束下无间隙的二阶充分条件。随后构造样本量 M 的 SAA：用 i.i.d. 样本的经验测度替换真实分布，求解经验问题的最优值与前 minimizer，先证几乎必然一致收敛与 M^{-1/2} 速率，再对 SAA 目标建立泛函中心极限定理，导出最优值的 CLT 与经验 minimizer 的渐近分布（约束不起作用时为高斯；多面体约束下为临界锥上带高斯线性项的二次规划解），并据此给出最优控制线性泛函的置信区间，最后用两个数值算例验证。
detailed_reading.result: 论文证明了经验 minimizer 几乎必然一致收敛，最优值的收敛速率为 M^{-1/2} 且与不确定参数空间的维数无关；最优值满足中心极限定理，经验 minimizer 在约束不起作用时渐近高斯，在多面体约束下其极限是临界锥上一个带高斯线性项的二次规划问题的解。基于这些极限分布构造的线性泛函置信区间在两个数值算例上得到验证，表明理论分布可用于实际的区间估计。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 对带不确定动力学的控制仿射最优控制问题，SAA 不仅有定性的一致性，还具备与参数维数无关的定量收敛速率和可显式刻画的渐近分布，因此可以直接支撑样本量选择、误差评估与最优控制的统计推断。约化目标在 L^2 下的二阶结构与 Hilbert–Schmidt 型 Hessian 是这些结论成立的核心机制。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键点包括：依赖于 Tikhonov 正则项与 Hessian 的 Hilbert–Schmidt 结构，才在 L^2 拓扑下获得二次连续可微并避免 two-norm discrepancy；收敛速率与参数维数无关源于 Hillbert–Schmidt/迹类性质对维数不敏感；分布层面要求 i.i.d. 采样，约束为逐点凸集（多面体情形可给出无间隙二阶条件与临界锥刻画）。局限在于结果只覆盖控制仿射动力学、开环控制、凸约束与可微终端代价，且正则项不可省略，对非凸问题、状态约束与反馈策略等情形尚未涵盖。

papers.title: A Probabilistic Lateral Motion Prediction Model with Improved Response Fidelity for Vehicle-in-the-Loop Simulation
papers.authors_text: Xiangyang Ye, Chaosheng Huang, Jinwen Yang, Zhengxian Chen, Jun Li
papers.abstract: Vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) simulation requires a lateral dynamics model that accurately reproduces vehicle responses and reliably generates horizontal lateral-position and heading commands through recursive integration. This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model with improved response fidelity. A two-degree-of-freedom vehicle model provides the physical prior, while a recurrent neural network learns correlated residual corrections to lateral acceleration and yaw rate. To maintain prediction fidelity during recursive motion generation, multistep rollout training feeds corrected responses into subsequent states and histories and directly penalizes accumulated lateral-velocity error. A conditional Gaussian characterizes response uncertainty, which is propagated to lateral-response, position, and heading predictions through augmented-state linearization. Evaluation results demonstrate improved lateral-response and integrated-motion prediction. Compared with the Deep Dynamics lateral adaptation, the proposed model reduces mean lateral-position root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 0.596 m to 0.483 m, an improvement of 19.0%, while reducing mean lateral-velocity RMSE from 0.0469 m/s to 0.0441 m/s. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining physical priors, probabilistic residual learning, and multistep rollout training for response-faithful lateral motion prediction.
papers.tldr: The paper proposes a physics-guided probabilistic lateral motion prediction model for vehicle-in-the-loop simulation that combines a 2-DOF vehicle model with recurrent residual learning, multistep rollout training, and uncertainty propagation, reducing mean lateral-position RMSE by 19.0% compared with Deep Dynamics lateral adaptation.

detailed_reading.motivation: 车辆在环仿真需要横向动力学模型不仅能准确复现横向加速度与横摆率响应，还要通过递归积分可靠生成横向位置和航向指令。现有混合模型多关注单步响应精度，预测误差在递归反馈中会通过横向加速度与横摆率的耦合不平衡累积为横向速度误差，导致自由运行轨迹漂移。因此，本文针对车辆在环仿真中响应保真与递归运动生成的一致性需求，构建概率化横向运动预测模型。
detailed_reading.method: 以线性二自由度自行车模型提供物理先验，在给定转向角、纵向速度和状态历史下计算名义横向加速度与横摆率；用128单元LSTM编码10帧转向、纵向速度、横向加速度和横摆率，输出归一化残差的联合高斯分布，经重参数化得到相关修正量并更新横摆率、横向速度和历史窗口。训练采用多步rollout，将修正响应和自生成状态递归反馈，损失由条件负对数似然、加权残差均值MSE和归一化横向速度MSE组成，使用4个粒子、λμ=0.05、λvy=0.2，并以验证horizon选择checkpoint。推理时以条件均值递归积分得到横向位置与航向，并通过44维增广状态在条件均值轨迹处线性化，将响应协方差传播到横向响应、位置和航向，输出点预测及±3σ预测带。
detailed_reading.result: 离线测试表明，多步rollout训练显著改善递归运动预测，训练horizon从1增至100时横向速度RMSE由0.2496 m/s降至0.0441 m/s，横向位置RMSE由0.934 m降至0.483 m。与Deep Dynamics横向自适应相比，所提模型将平均横向位置RMSE从0.596 m降至0.483 m，改善19.0%，同时将平均横向速度RMSE从0.0469 m/s降至0.0441 m/s；加入位姿损失后横向位置RMSE进一步降至0.452 m。消融显示去掉横向速度损失会明显恶化性能，验证了直接惩罚累积横向速度误差的必要性。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 物理先验、概率化相关残差学习与多步rollout训练的结合，可提升车辆在环仿真中横向响应和积分运动预测的保真度。该方法在保持物理解释性的同时提供不确定性传播，适合生成横向位置与航向跟踪指令；但结论主要基于离线数据评估，仍需在闭环车辆在环平台上进一步验证。
detailed_reading.key_details: 数据来自RT3000，共46条记录，其中44次换道和2次蛇形，按文件划分为33条训练、7条验证、6条测试，测试含六个机动窗口。物理先验为小角度线性二自由度模型，轮胎侧偏速度项在低速下正则化；残差为横向加速度和横摆率的加性相关修正，协方差以正标准差和有界相关系数参数化。关键超参包括训练horizon和验证horizon均为100、4个训练粒子、λμ=0.05、λvy=0.2、条件均值递归和32维增广状态协方差传播；评估指标为v_y、r、Y、φ的RMSE。局限性包括平面运动与小角度假设、固定物理参数、离线数据集规模有限，以及概率预测带仅通过线性化传播。

papers.title: Primal--Dual Kullback--Leibler Mirror-Prox for Dynamic Mean Field Games
papers.authors_text: Erhan Bayraktar, Ibrahim Ekren, Lu Vy, Ziqing Zhang
papers.abstract: We compute finite-horizon dynamic mean field equilibria using a primal--dual Kullback--Leibler Mirror-Prox algorithm. Each iteration updates occupation measures by exponential tilting and computes the dual correction by solving a linear PDE, without solving a nonlinear Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or a best-response control problem. Under assumptions and Lasry--Lions monotonicity, we prove an $O(K^{-1})$ ergodic Minty bound after $K$ iterations and an $O(K^{-1/2})$ approximate-equilibrium bound for the corrected average. We obtain convergence rates for the population flow under strong monotonicity, and for smooth diffusions with uniformly convex control costs under ordinary monotonicity. We also prove convergence of continuous-time Markov chain approximations to diffusion equilibria and, under additional smoothness and convexity assumptions, bound the error in terms of the spatial mesh size and the number of iterations. Galerkin approximations preserve the $O(K^{-1})$ estimates under suitable bounds on the correction errors. Numerical experiments illustrate the method and its convergence.
papers.tldr: The paper proposes a primal–dual Kullback–Leibler Mirror-Prox algorithm for finite-horizon dynamic mean field games that alternates exponential tilting of occupation measures with linear PDE dual corrections—avoiding nonlinear Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman solves—and proves convergence rates plus discretization and approximation guarantees.

detailed_reading.motivation: 动态平均场博弈（MFG）的均衡计算通常需要求解耦合的非线性 Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman（HJB）方程与 Fokker–Planck 方程，或通过反向动态规划反复求解最佳响应控制问题，计算代价高且对连续状态空间不友好。本文希望借助占据测度线性规划与原始–对偶变分不等式表述，设计一种每次迭代只需指数倾斜和线性 PDE 求解的算法，从而避免处理 HJB 非线性，并适用于无势结构的 Lasry–Lions 单调博弈。
detailed_reading.method: 将有限时域动态 MFE 写成乘积空间 Π×H^1(0,T;H) 上的原始–对偶变分不等式：原始变量为占据测度 π=(ν,(π_t))，经边缘映射 M 得到种群流 μ_t；对偶变量为代表 agent 的候选值函数 u，算子 F(π,u)=(C_{Mπ}-A^*u, Aπ-ρ)，其中第一块为终端与运行 HJB 残差，第二块为前向 Fokker–Planck 方程的弱形式残差。算法采用 KL Mirror-Prox：每个原始半步按当前 HJB 残差对 ν 和每个 π_t 做指数倾斜（相对熵近端步）；每个对偶半步加上 -τR(Aπ-ρ)，R 为 H^1(0,T;H) 的 Riesz 映射，该修正等价于求解以前向方程残差为源、以初末失配为边界数据的线性两点边值问题，并有显式公式（时间积分加一次 H 的 Riesz 映射）。实现上给出两种路线：在空间网格上用连续时间 Markov 链替换扩散，或在连续状态空间直接使用扩散生成元并用函数基/Galerkin 或二次能量最小化近似对偶修正；积分用求积或 Monte Carlo 计算。
detailed_reading.result: 在给定假设与 Lasry–Lions 单调性下，证明 K 次迭代后遍历 Minty 界为 O(K^{-1})，对可行比较点给出 O(K^{-1}) 的前向方程残差界，对校正后的平均占据测度给出 O(K^{-1/2}) 的近似均衡界；强单调性下得到平均种群流以 L^2-in-time Wasserstein 距离 O(K^{-1/2}) 收敛到唯一均衡流；在普通单调性加光滑扩散与一致凸控制代价假设下得到 Wasserstein 收敛速率。还证明连续时间 Markov 链近似收敛到扩散均衡，并在额外光滑与凸性假设下给出以空间网格 h=1/N 和迭代数 K 表示的误差界：取 K≥N 时种群与占据测度误差为 O(h^{1/6})=O(N^{-1/6})；Galerkin 近似在修正误差可控时保持 O(K^{-1}) 估计。数值实验显示有限状态拥堵博弈中前向残差、修正误差与 Stampacchia 间隙均以约 K^{-1} 衰减，网格扩散实验步长与网格无关。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 该工作给出了一种无需在每次迭代中求解非线性 HJB 方程或最佳响应控制问题的动态 MFE 原始–对偶 KL Mirror-Prox 算法，将均衡计算化为指数倾斜与线性边值问题求解的交替，并在 Lasry–Lions 单调框架下建立了遍历 Minty 界、前向残差界、近似均衡保证及种群流收敛速率；网格与 Galerkin 实现的理论与数值结果支持该方法的可扩展性，使其适用于无势结构的一般单调平均场博弈。
detailed_reading.key_details: 原始–对偶结构依赖占据测度约束 Aπ=ρ 与 HJB 残差 C_{Mπ}-A^*u；对偶空间选为 H^1(0,T;H)，对偶步的 Riesz 映射在有限状态空间为恒等、环面 Sobolev 空间为 (I-Δ)^{-m}、RKHS 中为对核积分。步长 τ 与相对熵强凸常数 λ 出现在 Minty 比较项 (D(π'||π_0)/λ+||u'-u_0||^2/(2τ))/K 中。关键实现约束是遍历平均未必可行，需用校正映射 proj_ρ 将其分解为流与松弛反馈并求解前向方程恢复可行性；若修正大小被前向残差常数倍控制且可行集有统一熵界，则校正平均的 Minty 间隙为 O(K^{-1})、Stampacchia 间隙为 O(K^{-1/2})。对偶可达性要求最优乘子属于 H^1(0,T;H)，强于可测对偶可达性；扩散结果依赖各定理附带的正则性与近似假设，网格误差界需 H^3 型 Sobolev 假设与凸控制代价，且可求和的对偶修正误差才能保持 O(K^{-1}) 遍历估计。

papers.title: Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring
papers.authors_text: Alejandro Casado-Pérez, Marija Popović, Daniel Gutiérrez-Reina, Sergio L. Toral., Samuel Yanes
papers.abstract: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80\% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1\% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.
papers.tldr: In multi-ASV informative path planning for oil spill monitoring, the calibration and closed-loop robustness of the reconstruction model’s uncertainty dominate final mapping performance over planner choice, with Evidential Deep Learning yielding the best-calibrated, lowest-error reconstructions in a single fast forward pass.

detailed_reading.motivation: 油污监测需要ASV舰队在严格时间和能量预算下，从稀疏含噪测量中重建非均匀污染物场，而信息路径规划（IPP）的性能取决于重建模型给出的不确定度是否能指示误差位置。既有工作多关注规划策略并主要依赖高斯过程，忽视了不确定度校准，且在闭环中模型会被自身不确定度引导的采样数据查询。本文因此研究不确定度校准如何影响多ASV IPP，并主张更校准的不确定度能带来更好的路径选择和更低重建误差。
detailed_reading.method: 将监测区域离散为二维栅格，把稀疏观测编码为两通道图像（访问掩码与测量值），用共享U-Net骨干完成场重建；MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles和Evidential Deep Learning（EDL）仅在不确度估计方式上不同，并与RBF核高斯过程基线比较。深度模型用异方差负对数似然在可航行掩码上训练，EDL输出Normal-Inverse-Gamma参数并以Student-t边缘似然训练，单次前向得到均值、偶然与认知不确定度；MC Dropout用多次随机前向、Deep Ensembles用多个独立模型估计认知不确定度。闭环中4艘ASV通过共享不确定度图在线协调，将归一化总不确定度交给Value-Greedy、Uncertainty-Greedy、ε-Greedy、Receding Horizon Orienteering和MCTS五种规划器选择下一采样点，并满足节点互斥与单艇电池/距离预算约束。为分离不确定度对路径与重建的影响，所有舰队采集的观测最终用同一网络重建，并在60幅物理油污模拟地图上评估RMSE、IoU和校准。
detailed_reading.result: 在60幅地图的闭环实验中，信息模型选择主导最终重建误差，解释约80%的方差，而深度模型间规划器仅解释约1%。EDL在所有五种规划器下均取得最低误差和最高IoU，是校准最好的模型，单步推理仅3.9 ms；每艇50个采样单元时，其重建效果仍优于每艇150个单元的MC Dropout和Deep Ensembles。Deep Ensembles在误差增大时反而更自信，而EDL不受此影响，说明其对自身规划器采集数据的鲁棒性更好。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 多ASV油污监测IPP中，不确定度校准比规划器选择更关键；校准良好的信息模型能让规划器选择更有信息量的目标，从而降低重建误差。EDL以单次前向提供快速、校准且对闭环自采集数据更鲁棒的重建与不确定度，适合实时不确定度感知的舰队监测。信息模型对自身规划器所采数据的鲁棒性应作为不确定度感知IPP的基本要求。
detailed_reading.key_details: 数据为60幅基于物理的油污模拟地图，场假设静态，观测含独立零均值高斯噪声，栅格已知且仅场未知；方法假设定位精确、通信瞬时无损、所有艇共享同一模型，并排除到达目标前的航行阶段。关键实现包括共享U-Net、可航行水域掩码、异方差NLL损失、EDL的NIG参数约束（ν>0、α>1、β>0）及Student-t边缘NLL，以及规划器使用归一化总不确定度进行排序。复杂度上，深度模型推理成本与样本数无关，但MC Dropout和Deep Ensembles需多次前向，EDL仅一次前向；GP精确推理随样本数呈O(D^3)且后验方差主要依赖采样位置而非测量值。局限性包括EDL的认知不确定度为启发式而非精确后验、实验基于模拟静态场、已知占据栅格和理想定位通信，真实动态油污与传感器/通信误差下的泛化仍需验证。

papers.title: Regularized Score Centering
papers.authors_text: Hao Bai, Chenlu Ye, Xuanchang Zhang, Aviral Kumar, Tong Zhang
papers.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.
papers.tldr: Regularized Score Centering (RSC) stabilizes asynchronous, off-policy reinforcement learning by adding a reverse-KL penalty to score centering—optionally with truncated importance sampling—to keep the learner close to the behavior policy, improving sample efficiency and achieving top performance on mathematical reasoning and diverse agentic benchmarks.

detailed_reading.motivation: 异步强化学习虽能提升训练吞吐，但陈旧策略数据以及训练与推理的数值不匹配会造成离策略学习不稳定。重要性采样（IS）虽可修正分布差异，却容易产生极端梯度；分数中心化（SC）能移除奖励基线对期望更新的影响，但当学习器远离生成数据的行为策略时仍会失效。因此需要一种既能保留 SC 的基线校正、又能限制策略偏移的稳定化方法。
detailed_reading.method: RSC 在 SC 的 token 级目标上加入反向 KL 正则：在每个历史处约束学习器与行为策略的下一 token 分布，目标由行为策略下的 token 优势项与 β·KL(πθ||μ) 组成，μ 在求导时固定并按采样策略刷新。其更新先对加权分数减去行为策略下的条件均值以完成中心化，条件均值用同一历史采样的辅助动作进行 Monte Carlo 估计；可与截断重要性采样（TIS）结合，对 token 重要性权重按上下界裁剪，SC 无 IS 可视为裁剪区间退化为 1 的特例。训练数据来自异步或周期性刷新的行为策略，方法不增加环境交互，只改变 token 级损失与权重计算。
detailed_reading.result: 梯度诊断显示完整 IS 会产生极端梯度，SC 能显著降低梯度幅度，但策略偏移较大时仍会失败。理论分析表明 KL 正则可改善收敛保证，反复拟合正则化目标后，最终策略单次响应的奖励可接近初始策略 best-of-N 采样的奖励。实验覆盖稠密与 MoE 模型、数学推理及购物、工具使用、游戏和全异步软件工程等任务；RSC+TIS 在所有 agentic benchmark 上提升样本效率，并在六个 agentic 任务最终评测中全部取得最佳，AppWorld 提升 14.3%，BabyAI 达到最强基线的 9.9 倍。
detailed_reading.conclusion: RSC 可视为 SC+KL（可选 TIS）的方法族，在保留分数中心化对奖励基线偏差校正的同时，用反向 KL 控制学习器相对行为策略的漂移。该设计对异步 RL、策略陈旧和训练-推理不匹配场景具有实际稳定化价值，并得到收敛性理论支持。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现包括 token 级反向 KL 以行为策略为参考、β≥0 控制正则强度、TIS 使用 c_low≤1≤c_high 的裁剪有效重要性比，以及用辅助动作估计中心化条件均值；行为策略在周期刷新或异步批次中按样本对应并固定求导。实验涉及稠密/MoE 模型、数学推理与多类 agentic 任务，强调相同采样响应数下的样本效率比较。局限在于中心化依赖 Monte Carlo 辅助动作估计质量，TIS 裁剪会引入偏差，且正则效果依赖行为策略参考的合理维护。

papers.title: Bias-Reduced and Parallel Heavy-Tailed Stochastic Convex Optimization in $\ell_p$ Geometries
papers.authors_text: Zhengyun Nie, Anant Shyam, Brian Bullins
papers.abstract: We consider the fundamental problem of parallel stochastic convex optimization (SCO), whose aim is to approximately minimize a convex objective when given the ability to query a moment-bounded stochastic gradient oracle multiple times in parallel per round. Whereas most previous results have focused on the variance-bounded Euclidean ($\ell_2$-norm) setting, meaning the objective is Lipschitz with respect to the $\ell_2$-norm over an $\ell_2$-bounded feasible set in $\mathbb{R}^d$, in this work we study parallel SCO in $\ell_p$ settings for $2 \le p < \infty$ under a heavy-tailed noise model. We begin by introducing a new class of $\ell_p$-optimal-distance-convergence (ODC$_p$) algorithms, drawing on prior stochastic bias-reduced techniques [ACJ+21], which combine with multilevel Monte Carlo methods to efficiently estimate the optimum of uniformly convex objectives. As a consequence of our ODC$_p$ algorithms, we first establish rates for projection-efficient $\ell_p$-Lipschitz optimization, composite convex minimization, and efficient $\ell_p$-proximal point estimation. Combining our ODC$_p$ algorithms with a new $\ell_p$-generalized Gaussian-based stochastic gradient estimator ($p$-GREG), we provide two efficient $\ell_p$ parallel algorithms, EpochDA and $\ell_p$-AC-SA, which achieve optimization error $ε> 0$ with at most $\tilde{O}(d^{\frac{p}{2p + 2}} ε^{-\frac{p}{p + 1}})$ query depth, improving upon the sequential heavy-tailed stochastic query depth of $O(ε^{-p})$ for $ε\leq \tilde{O}(d^{-1/(2p)})$. We also establish dimension-dependent lower bounds of $Ω\bigl(\min\{ε^{-p},d^{p/(3p-2)}\}\bigr)$ adaptive rounds for nonsmooth convex optimization over a subset of the unit $\ell_p$ ball. Our results improve upon the $Ω(\min\{ε^{-p},ε^{2/3}d^{1/3}\})$ bounds of [DG19], when adapted to the same feasible set.
papers.tldr: The paper develops bias-reduced \(\ell_p\) optimal-distance-convergence algorithms and a new \(\ell_p\)-generalized Gaussian gradient estimator to improve parallel query-depth guarantees for heavy-tailed stochastic convex optimization in \(\ell_p\) geometries, along with new dimension-dependent lower bounds.

detailed_reading.motivation: 现有并行随机凸优化研究多集中在ℓ2方差有界设定，ℓp几何下重尾噪声的并行SCO仍缺乏系统结果；本文旨在降低ℓp-Lipschitz凸优化在矩有界随机梯度下的查询深度，并给出相应下界。
detailed_reading.method: 提出ODC_p算法：把随机偏差缩减思想推广到ℓp-Moreau包络，直接用多层蒙特卡洛估计Moreau梯度以回避p>2时近端点映射非线性带来的困难；构造p-GREG的ℓp广义高斯重加权梯度估计器，再与ℓp球oracle加速结合，形成EpochDA和ℓp-AC-SA两个并行算法；同时导出投影高效ℓp优化、复合凸最小化和ℓp近端点估计流程。
detailed_reading.result: 在2≤p<∞、q=p/(p-1)矩有界重尾噪声下，两个并行算法达到误差ε的查询深度至多tilde O(d^{p/(2p+2)} ε^{-p/(p+1)})，在ε≤tilde O(d^{-1/(2p)})时优于顺序重尾的O(ε^{-p})；并证明单位ℓp球子集上非光滑凸优化的自适应轮数下界Ω(min{ε^{-p}, d^{p/(3p-2)}})，在相同可行域下改进已有Ω(min{ε^{-p}, ε^{2/3}d^{1/3}})界；还给出投影高效优化、复合最小化和近端点估计的复杂度结论。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 论文表明偏差缩减、MLMC与ℓp广义高斯平滑可在重尾噪声和非欧几何中协同降低并行查询深度，并建立维度相关下界，使ℓp并行SCO的上界与下界更接近；其意义在于把并行重尾优化从ℓ2推广到ℓp并改进特定域限制下的复杂度。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键设定是每轮可并行多次查询、复杂度以查询深度计，随机次梯度仅假设q阶矩有界；ODC_p通过MLMC控制偏差与对偶ℓq矩，EpochDA采用几何增长epoch、递减步长和epoch末平均，ℓp-AC-SA用自适应prox正则与加速权重；分析依赖ℓp-Moreau包络光滑性、p次幂正则和球oracle加速，常数/对数因子与维度相关，结果主要覆盖p≥2、重尾矩模型及特定ℓp可行域，下界针对非光滑凸优化子集。

papers.title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
papers.authors_text: Xingzi Xu, Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Karim Bouyarmane
papers.abstract: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2τ)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. We confirm all three predictions across five model families spanning four benchmarks. The closed-form solutions also enable principled method design: we prove that adding any label smoothing $\varepsilon > 0$ to SimPO creates a finite margin attractor at $Δ^* = β^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$, while $\varepsilon = 0$ (standard SimPO) has no attractor. We test this across three models (8B-9B) and confirm the prediction: the theory-derived configuration (TPO-S, $\varepsilon = 0.05$) is competitive with the strongest baselines, attaining the highest mean IFEval score among the compared methods on all three, validating that the predicted finite attractor is a usable operating point rather than proposing a new state-of-the-art loss.
papers.tldr: This paper introduces a margin-dynamics framework for LLM alignment, deriving closed-form one-dimensional margin ODEs that explain and predict differences among pairwise preference methods—such as DPO’s unbounded margin growth versus IPO’s bounded convergence—and uses the theory to design a label-smoothed SimPO variant (TPO-S) whose predicted finite margin attractor is empirically validated across multiple models and benchmarks.

detailed_reading.motivation: LLM对齐方法的选择主要依赖试错，缺少解释不同成对偏好损失为何在不同模型与任务上表现差异的理论。本文试图把对齐视为概率单纯形上的margin动力学，建立可预测且可指导方法设计的理论基础。
detailed_reading.method: 将固定prompt下策略在候选完成上的分布视为概率单纯形上的点，把各成对偏好方法写成切向量场F=F+−F−，投影到偏好/非偏好两个完成上得到一维log-margin ODE，并在梯度流下求闭式解。论文比较DPO、IPO、SimPO、KTO、PPO等的权重函数，结合标签噪声的mean-field分析和非对称加权的梯度集中分析，引入拟合的β_eff桥接多样本训练。据此证明SimPO加任意标签平滑ε>0会产生有限吸引子，并构造TPO-S（ε=0.05）及TPO-H进行验证。
detailed_reading.result: 理论预测DPO的margin无界增长（梯度流下约O(log t)），IPO收敛到有限值1/(2τ)。标签噪声使DPO从无界转为有界固定点Δ*=β^{-1}log((1−ε)/ε)，构成定性相变，而IPO仅定量移动固定点；非对称加权导致梯度集中于难样本并影响可训练性。作者在五个模型家族、四个基准上验证三项预测，并在三个8B–9B模型上确认TPO-S与最强基线竞争力相当，且平均IFEval最高。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 论文提出排斥类型、加权函数、参考模型三轴分类，解释成对对齐方法的动力学差异，并表明闭式margin解可用于原则性损失设计而非仅事后解释。有限吸引子被验证为可用工作点，TPO-S旨在验证理论预测，而非宣称新的SOTA损失。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键细节包括：分析在梯度流下进行，有限学习率带来O(η)误差，Adam被视为时间重参数化并由β_eff吸收。噪声分析采用mean-field近似，batch size B带来O(1/√B)波动，实验有效batch为4；β_eff按数据规模从干净数据拟合后固定。多样本桥接依赖跨样本梯度内积近似独立且均值零的较强假设，LoRA或主题相关数据可能破坏该假设；TPO-S取ε=0.05对应Δ*≈29，先验设定且无调参，并在8B–9B三个模型上测试。

papers.title: tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning
papers.authors_text: Andrew Leaver-Fay, Kieran Didi, Jeff Flatten, Alex Ford, Guangfeng Zhou, Nathaniel Corley, Hahnbeom Park, Maxwell W. Kazman, Rafael I. Brent, Joseph Kleinhenz, Henry Solberg, Andrew M. Watkins, Brian Kuhlman, David Baker, Frank DiMaio
papers.abstract: Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.
papers.tldr: tmol is a GPU-native PyTorch implementation of the RosettaGenFF forcefield that enables fast, batched, differentiable protein scoring and refinement—up to 362× faster than PyRosetta—and can be used as a machine-learning reward to improve generative protein design, e.g., by increasing interface hydrogen bonds and water bridges.

detailed_reading.motivation: 物理启发的力场能弥补生成式机器学习模型在训练分布外泛化不足的问题，但传统力场评估慢、导数难以接入ML框架；Rosetta能量函数及其离散侧链优化、扭转空间最小化等采样算法此前缺乏可微的GPU原生实现。
detailed_reading.method: tmol用PyTorch将RosettaGenFF力场重构为GPU批量化张量运算：体系按氨基酸残基或配体分块，邻居块对分配到一个32线程CTA，坐标与参数载入共享内存，分块计算原子对能量并累加每原子梯度；实现全结构/残基对打分、离散侧链packing、笛卡尔与扭转空间最小化及FastRelax，并用分段扫描在GPU上完成内坐标与笛卡尔坐标转换，所有打分与优化通过autograd返回坐标或扭转导数。输入管线可自动参数化配体、修饰氨基酸、D-氨基酸、修饰核苷酸和多数金属配合物，并加入金属配位项及DNA/RNA扭转势。
detailed_reading.result: 在1000个高分辨率蛋白结构上，tmol与PyRosetta各分项Pearson r均≥0.97、总分r=0.997；打分加梯度计算相对单线程PyRosetta实现233–362倍吞吐提升，扭转空间relax提升38–102倍。蛋白单体、蛋白-蛋白、蛋白-DNA诱饵判别、侧链rotamer恢复、配体对接和稳定性ΔΔG等基准总体相当，rotamer恢复因保留近天然rotamer而占优；配体参数化约1秒且无需人工检查。作为RFD4-Proteina束搜索奖励时，界面氢键和水桥增加，至少5对界面残基形成氢键的设计比例提高。
detailed_reading.conclusion: tmol使生成式ML、物理力场和物理引导模拟能够在同一可微框架内互操作，可作为生物物理先验提升数据受限场景下的模型泛化，并以开源BSD 3-Clause许可发布。
detailed_reading.key_details: 实现中修正了count-pair权重不一致、羟基扭转双重计数和表格势表示，并调整FastRelax以改善rotamer恢复；新增金属配位项及按Yanover-Bradley方案从DNA/RNA结构导出的扭转势。速度对比基线为单线程PyRosetta，评测覆盖1000个高分辨率结构及多类已发表基准；摘要未给出训练超参，且部分ML奖励的精确数值在全文预览中截断。

papers.title: Layerwise Learning-Rate Scaling in Vision Networks: Effective-Rate Identification, Power-Mean Aggregation, and Budget Dependence
papers.authors_text: Chandini Vysyaraju, Raghuvir Duvvuri, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov
papers.abstract: Layerwise learning-rate scaling assigns different learning rates to different parts of a network. Although established in fine-tuning pretrained models, its effects in vision networks trained from scratch are commonly assessed by training each candidate recipe. We show that, in this setting, the rate-related component of a layerwise strategy is well summarized by an effective learning rate computable directly from its multiplier profile. Across matched-control comparisons, changes in test accuracy closely track changes in training loss (r = -0.996), which supports an optimization-progress explanation of the short-budget rate effect. Increasing the untuned base learning rate tenfold shifts the rate-matched contrast upward in all six tested architectures (p = 0.016) and increases the number of architectures in which a published discriminative schedule, excluded from model fitting, outperforms the uniform control from two to five of six (p = 0.031). Within the evaluated strategy space, a parameter-weighted power mean with exponent 0.35 (95% confidence interval [0.20, 0.50]) accounts for 42.6% of within-architecture variance, compared with 36.4% for the arithmetic mean. Ranking candidates by this scalar without training improves the selected candidate's mean percentile rank from the 26th to the 10th and reduces its mean accuracy shortfall relative to the best candidate from 3.70 to 1.12 points. The rate-related effect decays as the training budget increases; relative to tuned baselines, the overall strategy effect falls within the prespecified practical-equivalence margin in two of three architectures. A separate grouping-related contrast can persist at long budgets, although its direction and magnitude depend on the architecture.
papers.tldr: In from-scratch vision training, a layerwise learning-rate strategy’s rate-related effect can be summarized by an effective learning rate computed from its multiplier profile—best aggregated with a parameter-weighted power mean (exponent ≈0.35)—enabling training-free recipe ranking, although the effect decays with longer training budgets while architecture-dependent grouping effects can persist.

detailed_reading.motivation: 逐层学习率缩放已在预训练模型微调中确立，但在从零训练的视觉网络里，其效果通常要靠逐一训练候选配方来评估，成本高且难以区分整体速率变化与分组本身的作用，文献报道也因此不一致。作者希望检验该场景下策略中与速率相关的效应能否由一个直接由乘数配置算出的标量概括，从而在训练前排序候选并厘清速率通道与分组通道。
detailed_reading.method: 作者定义 38 种逐层策略：36 种按参数顺序把张量分成 2–6 个连续深度组、划分比例从均分到 0.95/0.05，另 2 种循环分组，所有乘数均不超过 1。核心建模为速率响应模型 Δ_a(s)=β_a(M_p(s)−M*_a)+ε，其中 M_p 为参数加权幂均值、指数 p 跨架构共享，M*_a 为架构特异的盈亏平衡点，并加入近冻结指示项 −γ·1[m_min≤0.01] 刻画阈值式惩罚。关键操作是先由乘数配置解析计算 M_p，再对每种策略及其均匀对照、速率匹配对照和保均值变体在相同架构与预算下训练并比较测试准确率与训练损失，同时通过提高基础学习率十倍做干预、用未参与拟合的 ULMFiT 判别式调度做分布外验证。统计协议采用聚类稳健推断、小样本精确置换检验与等效性检验，实验覆盖多个视觉架构、21 个实验单元和 936 个策略注入模型。
detailed_reading.result: 在 21 个实验单元中，测试准确率变化与训练损失变化高度相关（r=−0.996），控制训练损失后与泛化间隙的偏相关为负，支持短预算速率效应的优化进度解释；基础学习率提高十倍使纯速率削减对比在全部 6 个架构中上移（平均 +4.7 个点，p=0.016），并使 ULMFiT 调度在 6 个架构中优于均匀对照的数量从 2 个增至 5 个（p=0.031）。拟合得到幂均值指数 p=0.35（95% CI [0.20,0.50]），解释架构内方差 42.6%，高于算术平均的 36.4%；不训练直接按该标量排序，使所选候选的平均百分位从第 26 升至第 10，与最优候选的平均准确率差距从 3.70 降至 1.12 个点。速率相关效应随训练预算增加而衰减，三个扩展架构中有两个相对调优基线的总体策略效应落在预设实用等效边界内，但分组相关对比可在长预算下持续，例如 ConvNeXt 在 100 轮增至 +6.4 个点而 GoogLeNet 反向。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 从零训练的视觉网络中，逐层学习率策略的速率相关效应可由乘数配置直接算出的幂均值有效速率较好地概括，且在短预算下主要表现为优化进度而非正则化；提高基础学习率会减弱速率削减的代价，提示从不同基础速率条件出发的研究可能测到不同贡献。参数加权幂均值（p≈0.35）优于算术平均，可作为无需训练的候选排序工具，但速率效应随预算增大而衰减、分组效应依赖架构并可在长预算下持续，因此评估必须区分速率通道与分组通道并明确预算条件。
detailed_reading.key_details: 数据来自 NNGPT/LEMUR 生成的 38 种策略、936 个策略注入模型及全部逐种子记录，策略空间限定为乘数不超过 1 的一侧，观测以训练损失和测试准确率为主，模型为线性速率响应加阈值修正而不引入额外正则化先验；聚合采用参数加权幂均值 M_p=(Σ w_g m_g^p)^{1/p}，以 p=0 的几何平均和 p=1 的算术平均为参照，指数由剖面拟合与聚类自助法给出不确定性。速率响应模型含架构特异 β_a、M*_a 与共享指数 p，近冻结阈值 0.01 并非拟合得到，而是由可用乘数取值决定，残差阈值只能定位在 0.01–0.1 区间；对照包括速率匹配与保均值两种变体，统计上使用聚类稳健推断、精确置换检验和等效性检验。局限在于策略空间未覆盖把部分组速率提高到基率以上的方案，模型只预测干预方向而非幅度，所测架构描述子未能预测架构特异的速率敏感性，且近冻结阈值受乘数取值的离散性约束。

papers.title: ASTRA: ASV Simulator for Transferable Realistic Autonomy
papers.authors_text: Tsimafei Lazouski, Cody Sheltraw, Alan Papalia, Maani Ghaffari
papers.abstract: Autonomy development for marine autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) remains challenging because field testing is costly and difficult to reproduce. Existing marine simulation tools provide mature capabilities in vessel dynamics, robotics integration, and visual rendering, but these strengths are emphasized differently across platforms. This paper presents ASTRA, an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and Robot Operating System (ROS 2) autonomy interfaces within a common environment. ASTRA incorporates a Fossen-style marine dynamics model together with geometry-based buoyancy and programmable spectral wave disturbances, enabling non-planar hydrostatic and wave-induced motion. The simulator reproduces the sensor configuration of a physical BlueBoat testbed, including GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and RGB-D sensing exposed through ROS 2. This allows localization, perception, planning, and control software to be developed against interfaces consistent with the physical platform. The BlueBoat's existing ROS 2 localization and perception modules were ported directly into ASTRA, while targeted zero-propulsion experiments were used to verify the implemented wave-body coupling. The simulated roll response was consistent with the expected non-oscillatory hydrostatic behavior, and heave remained highly coherent with the generated wave field, with approximately unity gain at the dominant wave frequency in the tested sea states. ASTRA is intended as an open-source testbed for marine autonomy development, simulation-based benchmarking, and sim-to-real experimentation.
papers.tldr: ASTRA is an open-source NVIDIA Isaac Sim framework that combines Fossen-style 6-DOF marine dynamics, geometry-based buoyancy, spectral wave disturbances, photorealistic sensing, and ROS 2 interfaces matched to a physical BlueBoat to enable transferable autonomous surface vehicle development and sim-to-real testing.

detailed_reading.motivation: 海洋自主水面艇（ASV）的自主性开发受制于现场试验成本高、可重复性差且测试场景有限；现有海洋仿真器虽分别覆盖船舶动力学、机器人集成或视觉渲染，但缺少在Isaac Sim中同时支持水面艇动力学、波浪—船体耦合、照片级感知与ROS 2自主栈的开源环境。ASTRA旨在填补这一空白，为全栈自主性开发、基准测试和sim-to-real实验提供可迁移的真实感仿真平台。
detailed_reading.method: ASTRA以NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.1.0为底座，将Fossen风格6自由度水面艇动力学、基于几何体的实时浮力求解器和可编程波浪谱扰动耦合到同一物理步回调中；浮力由BlueBoat浮筒代理网格的瞬时浸没体积及浸没顶点加权质心计算，波浪采用JONSWAP谱经TMA有限水深修正后在GPU上合成，并用1000个频率分量和128个传播方向生成时空水面高程，进而驱动升沉、横摇和纵摇。仿真器复现实体BlueBoat的GPS、IMU、LiDAR和RGB-D配置并通过ROS 2暴露，同时用29个现场测试bag中的零推力自由衰减段辨识平面阻尼，其中7段纵荡和7段艏摇分别拟合二次阻尼系数。
detailed_reading.result: 系统辨识得到纵荡中位R²=0.94、艏摇中位R²=0.96，参数为X_u=0、X_uu=7.77、N_r=2.46、N_rr=9.01；线性纵荡阻尼收敛到非负下界，表明测试速度范围内以二次阻尼为主。零推进验证中，仿真的横摇响应符合预期的非振荡静水恢复行为，升沉与生成波场高度相干，在测试海况的主波频处增益约为1，说明波浪—船体耦合在升沉方向上得到较好复现。实体BlueBoat已有的ROS 2定位与感知模块可直接移植到ASTRA中运行。
detailed_reading.conclusion: ASTRA可作为开源ASV仿真测试平台，用于海洋自主性开发、基于仿真的基准评测和sim-to-real实验；其价值在于在同一Isaac Sim环境中联合迭代动力学、感知、规划与控制，并保持与实体BlueBoat一致的ROS 2接口。
detailed_reading.key_details: 实现上采用仅含刚体惯性且无附加质量矩阵、阻尼矩阵对角化的低航速简化，除纵荡和艏摇外的阻尼系数为人工选取；浮力使用降采样代理网格和分段线性浸没体积映射，兼顾实时性与静水恢复及波浪诱导运动。波浪谱的总体幅值由用户尺度参数独立控制，尚未由风速和风程直接推断有效波高Hs，且虽采用TMA深度修正能量谱，色散关系仍用深水形式ω²=gk，有限水深色散留待后续；这些近似和局限是评估其波浪—船体保真度与sim-to-real适用边界时的关键。

papers.title: DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution
papers.authors_text: Lecheng Yan, Jianze Lin, Xicheng Han, Xiantao Xu, Wenxi Li, Chenyang Lyu
papers.abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.
papers.tldr: DeltaHarness is an execution-guided policy-search method that self-evolves tool-execution harnesses by using cold-start runtime measurements to adapt dispatch, revise physical plans, and select informative experiments, thereby reducing latency under varying resources.

papers.title: ARC-2: Continuous Compliance Through Delta Management
papers.authors_text: Tord Johan Eide, Einar Holt
papers.abstract:
ARC 1 introduced a three-layer governance architecture for autonomous systems comprising model safety validation, cognitive certification (CRAB), and operational authorization (LEA). However, it did not address how compliance should be maintained after deployment.
  This paper introduces Delta Management, a continuous governance framework that measures deviations between a system's current operational state and its certified baseline, defined as a region rather than a fixed point. Compliance is assessed through continuous monitoring instead of static certification.
  Four extensions are proposed. First, CRAB evaluation incorporates the worst verified behavioral deviations, with isolated outliers quarantined pending confirmation to prevent unjustified restrictions. Second, a layered trigger taxonomy distinguishes hard safety violations, critical single-dimension failures, correlated multi-system degradation, and risk-weighted composite indicators, each triggering proportionate responses. Third, a graduated safe transition protocol separates withdrawal of operational authorization from physical shutdown, consistent with established safety standards and EU AI Act requirements. Fourth, environmental delta is introduced as a distinct baseline validity condition: environmental drift beyond the certified Operational Design Domain (ODD) triggers recertification or ODD revision rather than automatic authority contraction.
  Together, these extensions transform ARC from a deployment-time certification architecture into a continuous framework for monitoring, evaluating, and enforcing compliance throughout the operational lifecycle of autonomous systems. The framework addresses the continuous compliance obligations established by EU AI Act Article 72(2).
papers.tldr: ARC-2 introduces Delta Management, a continuous post-deployment governance framework that defines compliance as the measured distance between an autonomous system’s current operational state and its certified baseline region, extending ARC with worst-case/outlier-quarantined CRAB governance, a layered trigger taxonomy, graduated authority withdrawal versus physical shutdown, and environmental-delta-triggered recertification or ODD revision to support lifecycle compliance obligations such as EU AI Act Article 72(2).

papers.title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
papers.authors_text: Harshit Samrat, Ramakrishna Paramahamsa Kompella
papers.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.
papers.tldr: After W4A16 quantization, the full-canvas logits/sampling pipeline—not the expert GEMMs—dominates single-user decoding of a 26B diffusion MoE because diffusion decoding processes S× more logits per output token, and the paper removes this cost with lossless/fused sampler optimizations to achieve 2.4–2.7× end-to-end speedup at unchanged accuracy.

papers.title: Hybrid Quantum Selection of Learning Rates in Language-Model Training: Termination Criteria and an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle
papers.authors_text: Wei-Che Hung
papers.abstract: Learning-rate choices strongly affect language-model fine-tuning, but the best joint profile across layer groups is generally unknown. This paper studies quantum minimum finding for layer-group learning-rate selection within a hybrid classical-quantum training framework. It combines Durr-Hoyer minimum finding with BBHT search and compares fixed-budget and confidence-based stopping policies using a lookup oracle built from measured profile scores at fixed training checkpoints. The paper then introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that scores and marks joint schedules in superposition without a precomputed score table. Classical one-step loss measurements supply the main, pairwise and three-way interaction effects between layer groups. The circuit adds the effects for each schedule, compares the resulting score with the current baseline score, and marks improving schedules for amplitude amplification. Measured candidates are checked classically before acceptance. Uniform-rate training supplies the initial baseline; using schedules from classical adaptive methods as baselines for joint refinement is left for future work. In closed-loop fine-tuning of a 1.5-billion-parameter language model, each selected schedule drives the next 200 classical training steps. Benchmark accuracies lie within the range observed across five uniform-rate seeds. The results give a working example of how quantum superposition can support adaptive learning-rate selection during training; the remaining quantum limitations are discussed in the paper.
papers.tldr: **TLDR:** The paper compares termination criteria for quantum minimum finding and introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that uses quantum superposition to select joint layer-group learning-rate schedules during closed-loop fine-tuning of a 1.5B-parameter language model, achieving benchmark accuracies within the range of five uniform-rate seeds.

papers.title: FACE: Flow-Guided Angular Channel Estimation Framework for mmWave MIMO Systems
papers.authors_text: Samitha Gunarathne, Eslam Eldeeb, Nurul Huda Mahmood, Matti Latva-aho
papers.abstract: Acquiring accurate channel state information (CSI) is essential for millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. However, it remains challenging due to high-dimensional channels, limited pilot observations, and measurement noise. To address these challenges, we propose flow-guided angular channel estimation (FACE), a novel channel estimation framework based on flow matching, an emerging generative modeling paradigm that learns continuous transport dynamics between probability distributions. FACE exploits the inherent angular-domain sparsity of mmWave channels and incorporates the learned flow matching model as a generative channel prior. Numerical results show that FACE consistently achieves higher channel estimation accuracy than both conventional estimators and diffusion-based generative estimator across diverse channel and system configurations. Moreover, FACE maintains high estimation accuracy with fewer pilot observations and achieves an average achievable rate close to the perfect-CSI benchmark. Compared with diffusion-based estimation, FACE requires substantially fewer sampling steps while achieving superior or comparable estimation accuracy, reducing inference time and computational cost. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates the potential of flow matching for accurate, pilot-efficient, and computationally efficient mmWave MIMO channel estimation.
papers.tldr: FACE introduces a flow-matching-based generative prior within a plug-and-play framework to exploit angular sparsity for accurate, pilot-efficient, and computationally efficient mmWave MIMO channel estimation, outperforming conventional and diffusion-based estimators with fewer sampling steps.

papers.title: AdaFlowLite: Scalable and Non-blocking Inference on Asynchronous Mobile Data
papers.authors_text: Sicong Liu, Fengmin Wu, Yuan Gao, Bin Guo, Zimu Zhou, Hongkai Wen, Zhiwen Yu
papers.abstract:
The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. %
\sysname pioneers the formulation of structured cross-modality affinity in mobile contexts using a hierarchical analysis-based normalized matrix. This approach accommodates the diversity and dynamics of modalities, generalizing across different types and numbers of inputs. Employing an multi-modal lightweight Swin Transformer (MMLST), \sysname facilitates real-time and flexible data imputation, adapting to various modalities and downstream tasks without retraining. Experiments show that \sysname significantly reduces inference latency by up to 80.4\% and enhances accuracy by up to 62.1\%, while achieving nearly a 50\% reduction in energy consumption, outperforming status quo approaches. Also, this method can enhance LLM performance to preprocess asynchronous data.
papers.tldr: AdaFlowLite enables scalable, non-blocking opportunistic inference on asynchronous mobile multimodal data by computationally modeling cross-modal affinity and using a lightweight multimodal Swin Transformer for real-time data imputation, achieving up to 80.4% lower latency, 62.1% higher accuracy, and nearly 50% lower energy consumption.

papers.title: Learning Calibrated and Samplable Predictive Distributions of Surface-Ocean $Δp$CO$_2$ Using Tabular Diffusion Models
papers.authors_text: Gabriele Accarino, Mohammad M. Amirian, Thea H. Heimdal, Amanda R. Fay, Galen A. McKinley, Viviana Acquaviva
papers.abstract: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO$_2$ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO$_2$ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Most existing machine-learning estimates of this field are deterministic, giving a single value per grid point, with uncertainty approximated post hoc via residuals, ensembles, or prescribed distributions. We instead learn a conditional predictive distribution for each observation: using Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, we estimate the full predictive distribution of $Δp$CO$_2$ (the sea-air $p$CO$_2$ difference) from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors. On a held-out SOCAT test set, Treeffuser attains the lowest continuous ranked probability score among the uncertainty-quantification methods evaluated (8.229 $μ$atm) and the coverage closest to the nominal 68% / 95% levels (0.686 / 0.930), while retaining point-prediction skill comparable to a deterministic XGBoost baseline (RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7 $μ$atm; $R^2$ 0.77 vs. 0.79). These results show that conditional diffusion can provide well-calibrated, observation-level uncertainties while largely preserving point-prediction skill. Because Treeffuser is generative, its samples can support probabilistic analyses of $Δp$CO$_2$; extending this to spatially coherent field reconstruction will require modeling dependence across grid cells and evaluation on spatially held-out data.
papers.tldr: The paper demonstrates that Treeffuser, a conditional tabular diffusion model using gradient-boosted-tree score functions, learns calibrated and samplable observation-level predictive distributions of surface-ocean ΔpCO₂ that achieve the lowest CRPS and best-calibrated coverage among evaluated uncertainty-quantification methods while retaining point-prediction accuracy comparable to XGBoost.

papers.title: Mechanism Design and Active Systems Theory: 60 Years of Parallel Development
papers.authors_text: Dmitry A. Novikov
papers.abstract: The survey compares two research traditions within the mathematical theory of designing the rules of interaction (mechanisms) for purposeful participants: mechanism design, together with contract theory and implementation theory, and the theory of active systems created by V.N. Burkov and developed into the theory of control in organizations (TCO) by D.A. Novikov's school; the main results of Yu.B. Germeier's school and of the domestic schools adjacent to active systems theory (AST) are covered as well. The problem statements and principal results of 2006-2026 are presented: for mechanism design (MD) - robust and dynamic mechanism design, multidimensional screening, information design, simplicity of mechanisms and credibility of the designer, market design, algorithmic and learning-based design, mechanisms for AI agents, and robust, relational, dynamic and algorithmic contracts; for AST and TCO - a general typology of control, strategy-proof and incentive-compatible planning mechanisms, decomposition of the agents' game, systems with distributed control and coalitional interaction, reflexive games and informational control, control of staff and structure, dynamic active systems, and project management. A correspondence between the classical results is established (the fair play principle and the revelation principle, the serial resource allocation mechanism and the uniform rule, active expertise mechanisms and generalized median schemes, quasi-compensatory incentive schemes and contracts under observable actions), and priorities are delineated by uniform rules; the areas where the two traditions diverge are identified, as are the dimensions of the problem (staff, structure, institutions, awareness, agents' beliefs) covered only by TCO.
papers.tldr: This survey compares 60 years of parallel development between mechanism design/contract/implementation theory and V.N. Burkov–D.A. Novikov’s active systems theory/control in organizations, mapping their classical correspondences, recent advances, divergences, classifications, applications, and expected convergence by 2035.

papers.title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.authors_text: Prithwish Jana, Nikos Kanakaris, Purak Jain, Anoop Deoras, Sahika Genc
papers.abstract:
Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements.
  We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.
papers.tldr: Inventa is a decentralized automated scientific-discovery framework in which autonomous research units evolve candidate ideas, locally adapt or restart stalled searches, and share only verified improvements and constraint violations, yielding more novel, feasible ideas and state-of-the-art results across five benchmarks with far fewer model calls.

papers.title: VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
papers.authors_text: Xin Guo, Arushi Rai, Xiang Zhou, Qiang Zhang, Siyu Lin, Xiangjun Fan, Lizhu Zhang
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.
papers.tldr: VisHead-Spec improves multimodal speculative decoding under high concurrency by routing visual attention through only a small fixed set of draft-model KV heads using top-layer target image features, thereby cutting image-token compute while preserving acceptance and increasing throughput over DSpark (16.0% vs. 9.5% at batch size 64).

papers.title: When Does Discrete Ricci Curvature Help? An Edge-Level Analysis of Curvature-Enhanced GCNs for PPI Prediction
papers.authors_text: Clara Joswig, Elham Gholamzadeh, Ghazal Mostofi, Nico Scherf
papers.abstract: Curvature-enhanced graph convolutional networks (CGCN) incorporate Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), grounded in optimal transport theory, into message passing, motivated by the claim that curvature-weighted edges alleviate "over-squashing" at structural bottlenecks. But does CGCN's improvement actually come from mitigating over-squashing? We investigate this on four real-world protein-protein interaction (PPI) datasets, comparing CGCN against a standard GCN at the level of individual edges rather than aggregate metrics alone. While CGCN improves aggregate AUC, AUPR, and F1 across all four datasets, this gain is concentrated almost entirely on low-degree edges, while performance on low-curvature (bottleneck) edges systematically degrades in three of four datasets, the opposite of what the over-squashing motivation predicts. Examining the learned edge-weight function directly, together with clustering-validity metrics, edge-distance ratios, and a layer-depth ablation across four depths, we find evidence for an alternative account: curvature-weighting sharpens the separation between clusters, which improves intra-cluster predictions at the cost of inter-cluster (bottleneck) ones. We test this account against topologically defined communities rather than the classification labels used elsewhere. Additionally, we offer practical guidance on when to prefer CGCN over standard GCN, depending on whether intra- or inter-cluster predictions matter most.
papers.tldr: Curvature-enhanced GCNs improve aggregate PPI prediction not by mitigating over-squashing at bottlenecks, but by sharpening cluster separation—boosting low-degree/intra-cluster edges while degrading low-curvature inter-cluster edges.

papers.title: An Open-Source da Vinci X/Xi Instrument Module for Laparoscopic Surgery Research
papers.authors_text: Douglas McDonough, Justin Liao, Jiawei Ge, Antony Goldenberg, Yvonne Zhang, Mackenzie A Eagleson, Ravi Prakash, Axel Krieger, Chunwoo Kim
papers.abstract: Studying electrosurgical tasks on a research robot requires control of both instrument motion and energy activation, along with a record of when each action occurs. This paper presents an open-source module for da Vinci X/Xi instruments on a UR5/UR5e robotic arm. Five motors transmit torque through timing belts to spring-loaded drive discs. An electrosurgical interposer accepts software commands, gives the surgeon's foot pedals priority, and records the source of each activation request. In bench testing, the interposer recorded all 12 activation and deactivation events from six pedal presses. Ex vivo demonstrations included monopolar and bipolar coagulation of splenic tissue and monopolar cutting during gallbladder dissection. Optical tracking of the Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps showed that calibration brought pitch and yaw gains from 0.904 and 1.14 to 1.00 and 1.02, respectively. The module enables researchers to record instrument motion, video, and the timing and source of electrosurgical commands during laparoscopic tasks.
papers.tldr: This paper presents an open-source da Vinci X/Xi instrument module for UR5/UR5e arms that combines five-motor instrument actuation with an electrosurgical interposer to enable software control and synchronized recording of instrument motion, video, and energy activation timing/source while preserving surgeon foot-pedal priority.

papers.title: Urban Representation Learning for Identifying Potential Disparities in Crime Reporting
papers.authors_text: Jorge Valverde-Rebaza, Carlos Paez De La Cruz, Pedro Pérez-Collado, Daniel Sánchez-Cataño, Eashley Martínez-Vergara
papers.abstract: Open crime data support urban safety analysis but reflect reported incidents rather than the complete distribution of criminal activity, potentially introducing spatial distortions in downstream analysis. We propose a self-supervised urban representation learning framework for identifying unusual reporting patterns relative to representation-similar peers using only georeferenced crime records. The method constructs complementary hourly, weekly, and static reporting profiles, learns scale-specific representations under geographic self-supervision, and integrates them into a unified latent space. Neighbor Profile Divergence (NPD) is then used to quantify disagreement between each region's reporting profile and those of its retrieved peers. Experiments on more than 1.8 million crime records from Mexico City, aggregated into 1,058 H3 regions, show that the proposed representation achieves a mean Silhouette score of 0.4052, compared with 0.2863 for Hex2Vec. NPD rankings remain highly stable across neighborhood sizes, with Spearman correlations from 0.9720 to 0.9951, while most high-divergence candidates persist across configurations. The retrieved peers also extend substantially beyond immediate geographic neighborhoods, indicating that the learned representation captures structure beyond local spatial proximity. High-divergence regions exhibit spatially organized patterns and, in several cases, differences in incident volume relative to peer expectations. These results support NPD as an internal auditing and prioritization mechanism for identifying regions that warrant further investigation, rather than as direct evidence of underreporting.
papers.tldr: The paper proposes a self-supervised urban representation learning framework that uses georeferenced crime records to retrieve representation-similar peer regions and applies Neighbor Profile Divergence (NPD) to flag regions with unusually divergent crime-reporting profiles for further auditing, demonstrated on 1.8 million Mexico City records without claiming direct evidence of underreporting.

papers.title: The Impact of Scenario Representation in Scenario-based Optimization Certification
papers.authors_text: Stephen Crawford, Nora Ayanian
papers.abstract: Scenario-based optimization provides finite-sample guarantees for decisions constructed from sampled uncertainty, but its certification procedures can be sensitive to how those samples are represented. We investigate this sensitivity under lossless scenario regrouping, which preserves the sampled information, feasible region, optimizer, and primitive violation probability. For an equal-allocation support-subsample certificate, we derive the distortion factor \(k^2(1-ε)^{k-1}\), establish certification reversals between equivalent representations, and provide sufficient conditions for acceptance dominance under nested coarsening. We further apply nondegeneracy-free Wait-and-Judge theory to coordinatewise scenario envelopes, enabling stronger certification directly from the primitive observations. In paired scenario-MPC experiments, exact regrouping increases certification availability from 318 to 471 of 480 attempts without changing the samples, numerical proposals, or requiring any reduction in witness cardinality. Primitive Wait-and-Judge certification accepts the same 471 attempts without regrouping. These results demonstrate that apparent scenario sample-efficiency gains can arise from certificate accounting rather than additional information or reduced decision risk.
papers.tldr: Lossless regrouping of scenarios can change scenario-based optimization certification outcomes—yielding a distortion factor \(k^2(1-\epsilon)^{k-1}\) and apparent sample-efficiency gains—even when the underlying sampled information, feasible region, optimizer, and violation probability are unchanged.

papers.title: TIBECG: Temporal Information Bottleneck for Lead-Specific Demographic Privacy in ECG Waveform Release
papers.authors_text: Tsai-Min Chen, Jun Seita
papers.abstract: Transmitting an electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform can expose demographic information beyond an intended diagnostic task. We evaluate TIBECG, an architectural temporal information bottleneck, on individual leads extracted from hospital twelve-lead recordings. A 2,302,337-parameter processor varies its latent length while retaining the same nine-score consistency objective, without age or sex labels in protector fitting. Across 6,386 recordings, ten folds, 12 leads and 21 lengths, retrospective selections retained at least 95% of each lead's clean macro-F1. Their weaker age/sex interval gain exceeded the best eligible conventional transformation on all leads, by a median 22.08 percentage points. The implemented sampling-rate comparison shows that direct downsampling usually suppresses demographic inference more strongly but at a larger loss of diagnostic utility, whereas TIBECG favors utility preservation. Selection stability also varies by lead. Lower latent Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence does not reliably rank residual sex leakage at a fixed length. These findings support lead-specific evaluation of waveform processing, not validated consumer deployment or expert-readable reconstruction. When the waveform-input diagnostic classifier is hosted as part of a proprietary cloud service rather than deployed on the device, waveform transmission is required to obtain its scores.
papers.tldr: TIBECG is a lead-specific architectural temporal information bottleneck that releases ECG waveforms with high diagnostic utility for a frozen cloud classifier while reducing age and sex leakage better than conventional transformations, though privacy protection and operating-point selection vary by lead.
